$comment: Registry of helper tools. The hub renders this list. To add a tool: create tools/<id>/index.html and append an entry here — nothing else on the hub needs editing.

tools.name: Status line builder
tools.tagline: Design the grid that sits under your Claude Code prompt, then copy the setup straight into Claude.

tools.name: settings.json explorer
tools.tagline: Browse all 80 settings with type, default and scope, then assemble a settings.json you can merge.

tools.name: Hook builder
tools.tagline: Pick an event, describe the behaviour, get a working hook block and the matcher syntax that goes with it.

tools.name: Skill scaffolder
tools.tagline: Generate a SKILL.md with correct frontmatter and a description that actually triggers when it should.

tools.name: MCP connector helper
tools.tagline: Build the claude mcp add command for stdio, HTTP and SSE servers, with the auth header pitfalls handled.

tools.name: Subagent designer
tools.tagline: Compose an agent definition file: tools allowlist, model, and a system prompt that stays in scope.
